reason: The ideal stable-reference counterfactual admitted forty-two rather than four guarded cells. Test the actually implemented constant attention reference with the same joint direction, guards, gap and F32 activation criteria.
direction_formula: Average the own-class coordinate and preceding-token coordinate after each is normalized to unit mean response relative to the physically carried reference. Remove the per-stage inherited class-carrier mean, using the earlier fifty factual questions only.
anchor_formula: reference_direction * median(actual_rms_on_fit) / reference_amplitude; this is an ordinary linear readout from the actual normalized residual, not an oracle RMS input.
gate_formula: If the cell mean direction separates every fit positive from guarded negative states by more than .05, place a paired-SiLU bounded ramp at .2/.8 of that gap, steepness160. Check the actual F32 activation bound .002 on all guarded negatives.
neutral_native_states: A protected native position whose already observed next token equals this cell target is neutral, not negative. Unknown following tokens remain negative; no EOS target is introduced.
